facts.fact: The Kenya National Bureau of Statistics says the draft Statistics Bill, 2026 and background documents are on its website and invites written comments by email, alongside in-person forums.

KEN.note: The consultation is on the Statistics Bill, which is not a digital law or policy as the study defines one.

facts.fact: The Kenya National Bureau of Statistics says it has developed the draft Statistics Bill, 2026, to repeal the Statistics Act (Cap. 112), and invites comments and holds public forums on 6-20 May 2026.
The Kenya National Bureau of Statistics says it is established under the Statistics Act (Cap. 112), which the draft Bill would repeal.
